vehicle versus pedestrian accident. upon arrival i spoke with reporting party/pedestrian william rhodes. rhodes told me that the accident occurred 15 minutes prior to my arrival, at approximately 1128 hours. rhodes was advised by his mother to call the police. rhodes stated as he was walking eastbound across the parking lot (towards his dorm) in the crosswalk. rhodes saw a vehicle unit 1 (described as a 2015, white, mercedes benz c 300, 4 door, txlp: [identifier]) traveling northbound towards him. rhodes stated that he was looking at his cellphone while he was walking in the crosswalk. rhodes said that he looked up and it appeared that the vehicle had accelerated towards him. rhodes said the driver/suspect appeared to be a female, later known as mia monroe. rhodes stated it appeared monroe was on her cellphone. rhodes said the vehicle collided into the right side of his body sending him onto to the hood of the vehicle. rhodes stated that he was able to somewhat jump onto the hood. rhodes hit the windshield, then he was tossed into the air, then landed on the ground the vehicle came to a stop. the vehicle backed up. the vehicle then pulled forward to the left side of rhodes. rhodes stated monroe got out of the vehicle to see if rhodes was ok. rhodes advised monroe that he was ok. monroe left the scene without giving rhodes any information. rhodes complained of pain and discomfort to the right side of his body, particularly his right buttocks/hip area, and his right elbow. rhodes also complained of pain and discomfort to his left ankle. med-10 arrived at location and evaluated/treated [medical facility]. rhodes advised me [medical facility] later in the day. there were no apparent injuries other than redness and swelling to the right buttocks/hip area. rhodes advised me on tuesday december 5th, 2023, [medical facility]. all x-rays taken on rhodes were negative, however he did complain of soreness to the lower part of his back.
